'''Dual Cenryia''', officially the '''Federal Republic of Dual Cenryia''', is a country in [[South Mahea]]. It borders [[Chaenia]], [[Seytinemas]] and [[Taing]] to the north; [[Byllu]] and [[Ocaun]] to the east; [[Exilium]] to the south; and [[Otiiric]] and the [[Ubrana Sea]] to the west. The territory has a varied landscape, diverse ecosystems, and a temperate climate. Dual Cenryia is composed of twelve provinces and is the third most populous member state in [[Mahea]], with over [[List of countries and dependencies by population|95 million people]], having a land area covering [[List of countries and dependencies by area|1,028,181 km2 (396,983 sq mi)]]. The capital and largest city is [[Vrandig]]; other major cities include [[Panstel]], [[Klemerda]], [[Grimsa]], [[Zalmar]], and [[Krunka]].

Prehistoric human activity on Cenryi soil dates to the [[Wikipedia:Lower_Paleolithic|Lower Paleolithic]], with continuous settlement since the end of the Last Glacial Period. Culturally diverse throughout late antiquity, the region became inhabited in the early medieval period by the [[Byaljicia culture Canrii]], who gave Dual Cenryia its name. The process of establishing statehood coincided with the conversion of a pagan Cenryi ruler to ____ in 670. The [[Kingdom of Kralka]] emerged in the 650s and later became the [[Partasi Empire]] in 843. The empire broke into 4 separate kingdoms: [[Conundrum]], [[Ufra]], [[Moonate]], and [[Howi]], and the latter two crowns were united in 1129, thus forming the [[Dual Cenryi Commonwealth]]. At the time, the Commonwealth was one of the great powers of [[Mahea]], one of the few that resisted the [[Kaastinial conquests]], with a [[wikipedia:Elective_monarchy|semi-elective monarchy]] and a uniquely liberal political system, which adopted Mahea’s first modern constitution in 1377.

With the passing of the prosperous [[Cenryi Golden Age]], the country was [[partitioned by neighboring]] countries through the 14th to 16th century. Becoming a [[Sivoso|Sivosan vassal]] in 1540, Dual Cenryia regained its independence with the founding of the [[Cenryi Republic]] in 1618, which emerged victorious in various conflicts during the interbellum. After the [[Treaty of the Globe]], Cenryi became an [[Emara|Emaran]] colony. Through the [[Red War]], several resistance groups emerged against Emara, which, after the [[Red War]], granted them independence in 1605. Dual Cenryia re-established itself as a [[wikipedia:Liberal_democracy|liberal democracy]] in 1722.

Dual Cenryia is a regional power in [[Mahea]] and a [[wikipedia:Middle_power|middle power]] in international affairs. Dual Cenryia's economy is the sixth-largest in Mahea, the [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|37th-largest in the world by nominal GDP]], and 24th-largest by [[wikipedia:Purchasing_power_parity|PPP]]. It is considered to be an [[wikipedia:Emerging_market|emerging market]] by the Global Trade Union.
